description: Two banks of seven buttons, each bank holding exactly one selection at a time and sending 10V from the output of the button selected

params.text: Selects that button in its bank and clears the other six; pressing it again leaves it selected rather than turning it off

inputs.text: Selects that button in the upper bank while this reads above 1V, and holds it selected for as long as the voltage stays high
Selects that button in the lower bank while this reads above 1V, and holds it selected for as long as the voltage stays high

outputs.text: Carries 10V while its button is the one selected in its bank, and 0V otherwise

notes: the first button of each bank comes up selected and a bank always holds exactly one selection, so a button can only be replaced by another, never switched off
both banks keep their selections when the patch is saved and reopened
